name: Winterhoof Cleansing Totem
summary: At Winterhoof Water Well, Venture Company poisons the water beneath Mulgore's plains. Mull Thunderhorn crafts a totem to cleanse it.

sections.title: Purifying the Spring
sections.body: Mull Thunderhorn crafts the Winterhoof Cleansing Totem in Bloodhoof Village. Venture Company goblins have tainted Mulgore's underground water with their operations. Mull imbues the carved wood with protective magic meant to wash away the foreign poisons. Carried past hostile goblin guards to Winterhoof Water Well, the totem channels a focused ritual that disperses the contamination. Pure drinking water returns for the plains' wandering herds and native tribes.

faq.q: What is the Winterhoof Cleansing Totem used for?
faq.answer: You bring the totem to Winterhoof Water Well, southeast of Bloodhoof Village, and perform a ritual that scours contamination from the aquifer.
Mull Thunderhorn, a respected tauren in Bloodhoof Village, carves and prepares the totem to undo the damage to Winterhoof Water Well.

faq.q: Why was the Winterhoof Water Well polluted?
faq.answer: The Venture Company establishes an encampment around the spring. Runoff, waste, and chemical sludge from its logging and mining machinery pollute the natural watering hole.

faq.q: What happens once the cleansing ritual is complete?
faq.answer: The murky water becomes clean and wholesome again, and local wildlife and migrating tauren herds can safely drink from the well.

angles.text: For tauren, the desecration of fresh water strikes at the heart of their bond with the Earth Mother. The totem's rite helps defend their homeland.
As a shaman, you wield the harmony of earth and water to cast out artificial corruption, in keeping with shamanic principles.
